# scc_privacy_management_policy (Resource)

Manages the PrivacyManagementPolicy object via New-PrivacyManagementPolicy / Get-PrivacyManagementPolicy / Set-PrivacyManagementPolicy / Remove-PrivacyManagementPolicy.

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.
- `privacy_management_scenario` (String) Maps to the -PrivacyManagementScenario parameter.

- `teams_location_exception` (String) Maps to the -TeamsLocationException parameter.

### Read-Only

- `identity` (String) Identity used to target the object in cmdlets.
